name: kinu
description: Kinu gives AI agents a durable computer of their own. It adapts and improves with use, runs locally or fully in the cloud, and solves hard tasks by exploring multiple approaches and letting executable checks choose the winner.
//workspaces: third_party/mossaic/sdk is @mossaic/sdk, vendored SOURCE at one upstream commit because upstream publishes no npm package. It is named exactly, not by a `third_party/*` glob: the closure it builds from (shared/, worker/core/) sits beside it at the upstream-relative paths its own imports and its `@shared` alias require, and those are vendored bytes, not packages.

scripts.test:spine: bun scripts/ladder.ts --run bun test --timeout=0 --isolate packages/agent-core/ packages/agent-utils/ packages/compaction/

scripts.test:workerd:devbox: bun scripts/ladder.ts --run vitest run --root packages/devbox tests/workerd/

scripts.check: bun run lint && bun test --timeout=0 --isolate packages/agent-core/drift.test.ts scripts/mossaic-sdk.test.ts && bun run typecheck && bun run gate:typecheck-coverage

//dependencies:@ai-sdk: The AI SDK v6 packages are pinned EXACTLY in every workspace that declares one (the root declares only what its own scripts and fixtures import), because upstream pins them to each other exactly: `ai@6.0.214` requires `@ai-sdk/provider-utils@4.0.33` and `@ai-sdk/gateway@3.0.139` by exact version, and each provider does the same. A caret on any one of them therefore does not age it independently — it floats that package ahead of the rest and bun answers with a SECOND copy of the SDK nested under whichever parent disagreed, which is how `@ai-sdk/provider` came to be installed twice while both manifests named one version. So the cohort moves as one edit. This one is GHSA-866g-f22w-33x8 (CVE-2026-8769, uncontrolled resource consumption in provider-utils' response handlers), whose first patched release on the v6 line is provider-utils 4.0.33; these are the earliest same-major releases that pin it. Later v6 releases exist and are also patched, but from `@ai-sdk/openai-compatible@2.0.70` the provider throws its own "Response stream ended without a finish reason" before a finish-step lands, which pre-empts the dead-stream detector in packages/core/src/chat.ts and the two contracts unit-chat-stream-integrity.test.ts holds over it. Moving past that boundary is a stream-integrity decision, not a dependency refresh. Float the cohort once upstream ranges its own packages instead of pinning them to each other.
//dependencies:effect: `effect` is pinned EXACTLY to 4.0.0-rc.117 wherever a workspace declares it (core; cf-backend for its workerd probe; the root for the red half of `gate:effect-diagnostics`), by owner decision on 2026-09-23: the error model runs on Effect 4's typed failure channel, and 4.0.0 is a release candidate (npm `rc` tag; `latest` is 3.22.2). A caret on an RC floats to the next RC, and RCs move API, so a bump is one deliberate edit in every manifest at once. `@effect/tsgo` is pinned exactly for the same reason: 0.45.0 lists TypeScript 7.0.2, and `gate:effect-diagnostics` fails when its planted floating effect stops being reported, so a bump cannot switch the check off in silence. Float both once Effect 4.0.0 is a stable release.
//devDependencies:bun: Canary 9bd19c98e contains oven-sh/bun#44279 for retired-realm crashes, but not spawnSync fix #44581 (13a98b0dbd). Use the newest canary, then return to latest stable once both fixes ship.
//patchedDependencies: Every other dependency floats on a caret, newest by default. A patched one stays exact, since its patch applies to that version alone; each floats again with its patch removed, once upstream ships the fix the patch carries.
//patchedDependencies:workers-ai-provide: 4.0.0's binding chat model hangs on a body workerd holds open after `data: [DONE]`, misreads the shapes `Ai.run` returns when a concurrent call rewrote its shared options, drops binding refusals' status and Retry-After, asks no stream usage, emits no raw chunks, swallows unreadable events, ignores call headers (`x-session-affinity`), merges index-less native tool calls, finishes tool calls as `stop`, reports `usage.raw` as `{ total }`, and reads no `workersAi` options. Delete once cloudflare/ai ships the fixes drafted in kinu-logs/agents-upstream/workers-ai-provider-binding-stream.md.
//patchedDependencies:@ai-sdk/provider-u: 5.0.53's `parseJsonEventStream` ignores `data: [DONE]`, so a producer that keeps the body open after it keeps the model stream open. Delete once vercel/ai ships the fix drafted in kinu-logs/agents-upstream/ai-sdk-sse-done-usage-only-chunk.md.
//patchedDependencies:@ai-sdk/openai-com: 3.0.62 requires `choices` on every chunk, so Cloudflare's usage-only report without it (KINU-049) fails the step. Delete once vercel/ai ships the fix drafted in kinu-logs/agents-upstream/ai-sdk-sse-done-usage-only-chunk.md.
//patchedDependencies:vite: 8.0.16's non-HMR prepareStackTrace runner retains fetched source beside V8's executed source and inline map URL. Cache the map once, omit its payload from execution, and release consumed source. HMR and native Node source maps stay unchanged; remove this patch when Vite releases that ownership.
